## Metadata
Title: FUN'S Cross-Word Puzzles
Author: Elizabeth M. Butzinger
Copyright: New York World
Date: 1914-05-03
Number: 20
Description: A 20x20 X: two diagonal bands of four-square rows meet in a cross-shaped middle (rows 7-14), with a two-square stem at rows 10-11; the number panel below the centre is outside the grid. The clues are printed in three places: down the left column (1-2 to 23-24), in four short columns under the grid (25-26 to 63-64), and down the right column (65-66 to 62-76); the xd keeps that order. The squares of Nos. 1, 14, 51 and 64 hold N, S, E and W, the four points of the compass.
Source: Milwaukee Sentinel, 1914-05-03, p. 95
